title: Live order status freezes on the first order
scenario: You are on the Swiggy order-tracking team. A user with two active orders reported that switching between them on the tracking page shows the wrong status.
symptom: Selecting a second order does not update its live status — the screen keeps showing the first order's status, ticking through its own stages forever, no matter which order tab is selected.
hints: Watch the Network panel after you switch to the second order — which order's status endpoint is still being polled?
useOrderTimer.js starts an interval inside a useEffect with an empty dependency array. What happens to the orderId that interval is using if orderId changes after the effect first runs?
The effect needs to both react to a new orderId and clean up the interval it started for the previous one, or the old interval keeps running forever.

rubric.description: The order-status polling effect in useOrderTimer re-synchronizes when orderId changes and clears its previous interval before starting a new one, instead of running once with an empty dependency array.
After selecting a different order, the status shown advances based on that order's own polling, not the previously selected order's.

The displayed status still comes from the response of GET /api/orders/{id}/status for the currently selected order. It is not a hardcoded status sequence, a value set without a request, or a local stub that ignores the mock API.
The first selected order's status still progresses correctly through repeated polls for as long as it remains selected.
